summary: 66-year-old man 6 days after endoscopic mucosal resection of a 30 mm ascending colon polyp, clopidogrel restarted on day 2, now with four episodes of fresh and maroon blood, HR 98, Hb 11.2 (baseline 13.8). Needs admission and repeat colonoscopy with endoscopic haemostasis (clips).

inputs.chiefComplaint: Bleeding from the back passage after a colonoscopy
inputs.hpi: Six days after endoscopic mucosal resection (EMR) of a 30 mm flat polyp in the ascending colon. Clopidogrel restarted on day 2 as advised. Since this morning four episodes of fresh and maroon blood per rectum, lightheaded on standing. No abdominal pain, no fever.

exam.general: Alert, pale. HR 98, BP 128/74, postural drop 18 mmHg.

surgicalHistory: Endoscopic mucosal resection, 30 mm ascending colon polyp (6 days ago)

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Delayed post-polypectomy bleeding (day 6 after EMR)
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Delayed post-polypectomy haemorrhage 6 days after EMR of a 30 mm ascending colon polyp, on clopidogrel. Stable but ongoing bleeding.

mustInclude.note: Early repeat colonoscopy to treat the post-polypectomy site (not a routine/screening colonoscopy).
ESGE 2017: delayed post-polypectomy bleeding with ongoing bleeding → colonoscopy and endoscopic haemostasis (clips; thermal coagulation).
mustInclude.knownGapNote: No post-polypectomy bleeding protocol (K91.840 has none); the only plan is the generic GI-bleed prompt without endoscopic haemostasis/clips.
mustInclude.proposedFix: Add a post-polypectomy bleed rule (post-procedure + rectal bleeding): repeat colonoscopy with endoscopic haemostasis (ESGE).

mustInclude.note: Temporary interruption of clopidogrel decided with cardiology (recent-ish coronary stent).

guideline.name: BSG guideline — diagnosis and management of acute lower gastrointestinal bleeding
guideline.section: Stable bleeding requiring admission; antiplatelet management
guideline.citation: Oakland K, Chadwick G, East JE, et al. Diagnosis and management of acute lower gastrointestinal bleeding: guidelines from the British Society of Gastroenterology. Gut. 2019;68:776–789.

guideline.name: ESGE guideline — colorectal polypectomy and endoscopic mucosal resection
guideline.section: Delayed post-polypectomy bleeding: colonoscopy with endoscopic haemostasis; resumption of antithrombotics
guideline.citation: Ferlitsch M, Moss A, Hassan C, et al. Colorectal polypectomy and endoscopic mucosal resection (EMR): European Society of Gastrointestinal Endoscopy (ESGE) Clinical Guideline. Endoscopy. 2017;49:270–297.

rationale: Permutation: post-procedural bleed on an antiplatelet. There is no post-polypectomy bleeding protocol; this checks the plan still sends the patient back for endoscopic therapy rather than treating it as undifferentiated rectal bleeding.
